role: The gold (147, light) and iron (148, heavy) weighted plates: power is the entity count over the weight cap, scaled to 15.
scope_reason: In scope: gold and iron weighted plates are craftable and placeable, and an entity standing on one makes the oracle write its power level as metadata (BlockBasePressurePlate.func_150062_a over this class's func_150065_e) even with redstone = off.

members.name: func_150065_e
members.note: min(count, cap)/cap * 15 ceil; the count is sr_box_count_all (every entity in the chunk lists, a dead one until its removal)

notes: Support and drops through BlockBasePressurePlate (blockcb.c case 147/148, drops.c plate case). idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/containers 2026-09-27: stepping on a weighted plate is native (collide.c 147/148, the servertick update_tick case, serverreplay.c sr_plate_count); plates-s1 steps on both.
